page.overview:
Who is Marasi Colms?

Marasi Colms is a Pulser on Scadrial. Marasi is a constable in the Elendel constabulary under Constabthumble-General Reddi. Marasi previously studied law and is a friend of Wax, Wayne, and MeLaan, among other important cultural figures of the time.
